hook: Drilling small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand.
hooks: Drilling small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand.
A scored groove cracked the aluminum; drilled holes folded clean.
Create complex curves with hand tools and patience.
what_happened: John drilled small holes along each curved fold line, then bent the aluminum by hand to create the desired shape.
why_it_matters: It shows curved folds in aluminum can be made with hand tools and patience, no fancy machines.
the_catch: The finished part keeps small perforations along each fold, and it needs finishing and straightening.
caption: Drilling a line of small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand without fancy tools. Could you replace a scoring groove with this hole‑perforation technique on your next project?
alt_text: The carousel explains that drilling a series of tiny holes along a curved line creates a weak spot that lets you bend aluminum by hand, avoiding cracks and fancy equipment.

es.hook: Taladrar pequeños agujeros permite doblar a mano láminas de aluminio en curva.
es.what_happened: John taladró pequeños agujeros a lo largo de cada línea de pliegue curvo y luego dobló manualmente el aluminio para obtener la forma deseada.
es.why_it_matters: Demuestra que los pliegues curvos en aluminio pueden lograrse con herramientas manuales y paciencia, sin necesidad de máquinas sofisticadas.
es.the_catch: La pieza terminada conserva pequeñas perforaciones a lo largo de cada pliegue y requiere acabado y enderezado.
